title: `prompts/list`
description: Lists the prompt templates a server exposes, with their names, titles, descriptions and argument definitions.
question: Can the agent discover the server's prompts?
why: Prompts are the user-controlled primitive: the slash commands and menu entries a server contributes to the host. A framework that ignores them silently discards a third of what the server publishes, and the omission is invisible because nothing errors.
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers publishing this. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

notes.crewai: CrewAI 1.15.26: `crewai_tools.MCPServerAdapter` exposes only `tools`. It has no resource or prompt API, so an agent built on it cannot reach this at all.
notes.genkit_js: Genkit (JS) 1.42.0: `getActivePrompts` returns an `ExecutablePrompt` per MCP prompt whose `ref.metadata` keeps `description` and `arguments`; `title` is not kept.
notes.langchain: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2: the package has no API for listing prompts. `load_mcp_prompt` can expand a prompt the caller already knows by name, but nothing tells the agent which prompts exist or what arguments they take.
notes.google_adk: Google ADK 2.11.0: `McpToolset` has no prompt methods; `prompts/list` is never sent.
notes.ms_agent_framework: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.21.0: prompts are listed only as the `FunctionTool`s `load_prompts` builds, one per prompt, which the model can call like tools. Name, description and arguments survive; the prompt's `title` does not.
notes.openai_agents_js: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) 0.20.0: the `MCPServer` interface (agents-core `src/mcp.ts`) has tools and resources methods but no prompts method.
notes.semantic_kernel: Semantic Kernel 1.45.0: prompts become KernelFunctions (`load_prompts`); a prompt's name, description and arguments survive, its title does not.
notes.pi: Pi (@earendil-works/pi-mcp 1.1.0): `McpClient` has no prompts method; `prompts/list` is reachable only by hand through the generic `request()`.
notes.google_adk_js: Google ADK (TypeScript) 2.2.1: `MCPToolset` has no prompt API (`listPrompts`), and ADK adds none elsewhere.
notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: `MCPTools` lists and calls tools only; it has no resource or prompt API, so `prompts/list` is unreachable.
notes.haystack: Haystack (mcp-haystack 1.5.2): `MCPToolset` wraps tools as Haystack `Tool`s and has no resource or prompt API, and the `ClientSession` it opens is private to `MCPToolset._worker._client`, so there is no route to `prompts/list`.
notes.smolagents: smolagents 1.26.0 (mcpadapt 0.1.20): `smolagents.MCPClient` exposes only `get_tools()`, and the `ClientSession` lives on the private `MCPClient._adapter`. It has no resource or prompt API, so an agent built on it cannot reach this at all.
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: DSPy's MCP support is `dspy.Tool.from_mcp_tool`, which converts one tool. It has no resource or prompt API, so resources and prompts stay on the caller's MCP session.
notes.langchain_js: LangChain.js (@langchain/mcp-adapters 2.0.1): `MCPAdapter` has no prompts API (no list, get or loader for prompts), so there is no route to `prompts/list`.
notes.beeai: BeeAI Framework 0.1.85: `beeai_framework.tools.mcp` has `MCPTool` only. `MCPTool.from_client` lists and wraps tools, and BeeAI has no MCP resource or prompt API.
notes.crewai-native: CrewAI 1.15.26, native `crewai.mcp` client (`Agent(mcps=[...])`, not the `crewai_tools.MCPServerAdapter` row): `MCPClient.list_prompts` returns each prompt as `name`, `description` and `arguments` only, so the prompt's `title` is dropped. The agent itself is not handed prompts; they are reachable only by calling `MCPClient` directly.
notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: `McpPrompt` holds `name`, `description` and `arguments`; `prompts/list` loses each prompt's `title`.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): `mcptoolset.Toolset` exposes only `Tools()`, and the `*mcp.ClientSession` it opens stays inside its unexported `connectionRefresher`, so the caller has no session to call `ListPrompts` on.
